LLM backend for mapping repair

llmBackend.Rd

Configure the model repairMapping() may ask to choose among repair options. Settings come from the arguments or the environment: GIOTTO_LLM_PROVIDER ("anthropic", "ollama" or "baseline"), GIOTTO_LLM_MODEL, and for Anthropic ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN), for Ollama OLLAMA_HOST (default http://localhost:11434). Keys are read at call time and never stored or logged.

"baseline" uses no model: it takes the top-ranked candidate path when its score leads the next one by at least min_lead, and makes no param choices. It is the reference an LLM backend has to beat.

Usage

llmBackend(
  provider = Sys.getenv("GIOTTO_LLM_PROVIDER"),
  model = Sys.getenv("GIOTTO_LLM_MODEL"),
  host = Sys.getenv("OLLAMA_HOST", "http://localhost:11434"),
  max_tokens = 2048L,
  min_lead = 0.5
)

Arguments

provider

"anthropic", "ollama" or "baseline"

model

model id. Anthropic defaults to "claude-haiku-4-5"; Ollama needs one (e.g. "qwen3.8:27b").

host

Ollama host

max_tokens

maximum response tokens

min_lead

baseline only: required score lead of the top candidate

Value

an llmBackend list
